blockers.title: Historical strategy digest change detector mismatch
blockers.description: 5 historical tests pin pre-Phase-4 Windows uncommitted digest c52e648c... Current working tree is 9c56f3ff... (disk raw) and ba17582d... (LF canonical). Retained failing red by contract per safety rule #7.
blockers.remediation: Do not rewrite historical test pins. Maintain decoupled modular architecture.

blockers.title: Historical ADAUSD position closure unverified
blockers.description: Historical ADAUSD position belonged to a pre-rotation account credential. Current testnet account is verified flat, but historical closure on original account cannot be proved without original venue ledger captures.
blockers.remediation: Retain unverified status until original account records are authorized and produced.

blockers.title: Multi-observation statistical power gate unreached
blockers.description: Authenticated venue executions currently stand at N = 2 fills. Statistical significance requires N >= 30 fills under diverse market conditions.
blockers.remediation: Follow the Phase 174 authorized testnet protocol once operator grants written approval.

blockers.title: Restricted raw venue capture containment
blockers.description: 12 internal evidence captures contain restricted network telemetry. Must not be published publicly without authorized sanitization.
blockers.remediation: Enforce privacy scanner and keep internal captures sealed.

blockers.title: Multi-year 2024-2026 continuous tick/L2 depth unsupplied
blockers.description: The repository contains verified 1m parquet candles covering 1,440 minutes (2026-09-05T21:35:00Z to 2026-09-06T21:34:00Z) and 113 high-frequency L2 orderbook frames. Continuous multi-year 2024-2026 tick and depth data is absent from repository assets.
blockers.remediation: Classify multi-year evaluations as parameter-based simulations under assumptions; do not claim empirical verification across 2024-2026 until raw tick datasets are ingested.

blockers.title: Maker execution does not establish edge for micro-scalps
blockers.description: Under conservative queue and adverse selection assumptions, micro-scalps (< 50 pts) fail the friction hurdle gate even with pure maker fees due to fee drag, adverse selection drift, and non-fill opportunity cost.
blockers.remediation: Enforce pre-order FrictionHurdleGate to reject negative-expectancy scalps; restrict trading to target structures >= 150 points.

blockers.title: Queue fill probability model unverified by empirical MBO data
blockers.description: The reported 86.47% and 86.20% fill probabilities reflect an exponential block hazard assumption (1 - exp(-lambda*t/Q)). Level-2 aggregated order books cannot verify individual order queue priority or queue depletion without Market-by-Order (MBO / Level 3) data.
blockers.remediation: Label queue dynamics output strictly as SIMULATION_ASSUMPTION until high-frequency order-level tick feeds are acquired.
